headline: 7-run loss: Australia win T20I series against Bangladesh
summary: Despite a valiant late-game effort from Towhid Hridoy, the Tigers fall short in the second T20I in Chattogram, conceding the series 2-0.
details: Bangladesh lost the second T20I by seven runs, ending their chase at 189/6 against Australia's massive total of 196. Stand-in skipper Towhid Hridoy led a brave late charge, scoring 35 off 22 balls, but was caught in the final over with eight runs still needed.

Earlier in the innings, Tanzid Hasan provided a quick 30 off 15 balls, while Saif Hassan played a steadier knock of 42 off 33. Parvez Hossain Emon also contributed a rapid 36, but Australia's bowling attack, led by Aaron Hardie (2-40), kept the pressure on.

Australia's total was powered by a brutal fifth-wicket partnership of 97 runs in just 50 balls between Matt Renshaw and Tim David. Renshaw remained unbeaten on 89 off 52, hitting five sixes and four fours, while David added 45 off 26.

The Tigers had a strong start with early wickets, including a cutter from Mustafizur Rahman that led to a stunning catch by Saif Hassan. Nasum Ahmed also reached a milestone, taking his 50th T20I wicket in his 50th match.
Despite the loss, the two teams will face each other one last time this Sunday in the final T20I in Chattogram.

headline: 670 deaths: 4 more children die from measles symptoms
summary: The total death toll from measles symptoms has risen to 670 following the recent deaths of four more children.
details: Four more children have died after exhibiting symptoms of measles, bringing the total number of deaths to 670.
The deaths are linked to the symptoms of the disease, highlighting a critical health crisis affecting young children.
Health authorities continue to monitor the situation as the number of fatalities increases.
